title: nan
authors: Youn W.; Ko H.; Choi H.; Choi I.; Baek J.-H.; Myung H.
key_contribution: Presents an integrated UAV navigation system fusing RGB-D visual odometry, 2D LiDAR, altimeter, and ESKF into pose-graph SLAM with collision-free path planning in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
